mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Verification Policy

TLS certificate verification is required on all builds, including development builds, with no exceptions. Development builds must not skip or disable certificate verification, so that development does not build habits or code paths that bypass this security check.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
